messages:
Maya Singh: Heads-up 10am PT - Aurora Systems is escalating. CFO wants an exec signoff call Friday 9am PT. Two blockers: customer-managed KMS for PHI and a scoped SOC2 excerpt under NDA. Need plan.
Ethan Cole: I can draft the technical runbook. Quick answer: BYO-KMS is supported for Private deployments today; Dedicated requires contract addendum.
Jordan Bell: Legal: we have an SOC2 redaction package and a PHI addendum template. I'll prepare NDA + redaction checklist.
Rita Kapoor: Sales: they're asking for a 90-day POC on Dedicated with a 20% discount. Recommend countering with Private + 10% + credits.
Maya Singh: Exec asks: can a VP join the call? This is a deal-committee level decision. Also they want an ETA on provisioning.
Ethan Cole: Provisioning ETA: Private in their VPC = ~48-72h after IAM role and CIDR; Dedicated on our side = ~24-48h but no BYO-KMS without addendum.
Jordan Bell: Action items: legal will draft NDA + PHI addendum by tomorrow 11am. Send me the customer KMS vendor name so I can tailor language.
Rita Kapoor: I'll prepare pricing slide: propose 12% off + $30k credits for POC, convert-to-reserved discounts if they sign a 6mo commit.
OpsBot: [reminder] Created calendar "Aurora exec POC signoff" Fri 09:00 PT  attendees: Maya, Ethan, Jordan, Rita.
Maya Singh: Pre-call ask to customer: 1) KMS vendor + attestation PDF 2) CIDR for peering 3) IAM role ARN 4) list of people on their side for the call.
Ethan Cole: I'll build a one-slide KMS diagram + config snippet for the demo showing key binding and peering.
Jordan Bell: If they insist on Dedicated + BYO-KMS, pause and escalate to legal & contracts immediately. Don't promise live key control until addendum signed.
Rita Kapoor: I'll loop in VP and solicit availability. Will share pricing counter in this thread by 3pm PT.
Maya Singh: Thanks team. Let's have the materials uploaded to the invite 24h prior. I'll send the pre-call note in 20m. :thumbsup:
